title: Contact
description: The verified (or not-yet-verified) recipient for one lead's outreach email, at data/leads/<slug>/contact.json. Produced by prompts/contact-verification.md + scripts/verify_contact.py. Hard rule: an email address that wasn't found on a public source -- only guessed/inferred (e.g. assuming info@domain.com) -- can never be marked contact_verified: true, and a prospect can never reach EMAIL_DRAFT_READY without one.

contact_name.description: null if only a company inbox was found, not a named person

role.description: Priority order for outreach: owner/founder > marketing_manager > operations_manager > company_inbox

source_url.description: Where this exact email/name was found -- required if contact_verified is true

source_type.description: 'guessed' can NEVER pair with contact_verified: true

contact_verified.description: true only if the email was found on a public, credible source -- never for an inferred/guessed address
